pairsWith.noteUz: 9-10-unitlar (A World of Wonders, Stick to the Rules!) bo'yicha nazorat testi: majhul nisbat, o'zlik olmoshlari (myself/yourself), too/enough, must/mustn't/should, xavfsizlik qoidalari, muzey va diqqatga sazovor joylar.

scanNote:
PROGRESS TEST 5 - Units 9-10 (77-bet, PDF 69). Yuqorida to'q sariq 'PROGRESS TEST 5' va 'Units 9-10'. Katakchalar: NAME, CLASS, DATE, MARK, (Time: 20 minutes).

'Vocabulary & Grammar':
1) 'Fill in the missing words.' 1 We enjoyed ...... a lot at the party. 2 David Copperfield ...... written by Charles Dickens. 3 ...... collection will be on display? 4 Young children ...... play near ponds. 5 The mayor will ...... invited to the opening of the hospital. 6 He isn't old ...... to drive a car. 7 Has the gallery ...... opened to the public yet? 8 The building ...... destroyed by fire in 1788. 9 "I don't have to water the plants." "...... do I." 10 "...... was the museum completed?" "In 1887." 11 The building was used ...... a place of worship. 12 Be careful with the knife or you'll cut ...... . 13 It's ...... cold to play in the garden. 14 You'll ...... amazed by the scenery. 15 You aren't ...... to smoke in here. 16 You must stay ...... from people you don't know well. 17 ...... play with matches. 18 Don't ...... your children go swimming alone. 19 "......'s her job?" "She's a teacher." 20 You ...... cover electrical sockets when they are not in use.
2) 'Choose the correct item.' 1 What do they ...... for admission for children? A declare B cast C charge. 2 America was ...... by Christopher Columbus. A discovered B composed C invented. 3 Notre Dame is ...... in Paris, France. A located B built C designed. 4 Don't play with electrical sockets. You could give yourself an electric ...... . A accident B pot C shock. 5 Pythons have got ...... teeth. A natural B strong C sharp. 6 Help ...... put these in the cupboard please. A mine B me C my. 7 The museum will be opened ...... the Queen. A by B from C of. 8 Be careful, or you'll ...... into the pond. A be B fall C drop. 9 You shouldn't touch the ...... in a museum. A exhibitions B landmarks C exhibits. 10 He was seriously ...... in a car accident. A damaged B hurt C injured.

'Communication':
3) 'Complete the dialogues.' 1 A: ...... to get in? B: Admission is £10 for adults. 2 A: ...... photographs of the statues? B: I'm afraid not sir. 3 A: I have to do the ironing tomorrow. B: ......, but I don't have to do the shopping. 4 A: ...... jacket made of? B: It's made of leather. 5 A: ...... telephone invented by? B: Alexander Graham Bell.

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '77'.

exercises.explanationUz:
9-10-UNITLAR TAKRORI - 20 ta
  bo'shliq.

  MAJHUL NISBAT: WAS written by
    Dickens; will BE invited; Has
    the gallery BEEN opened?; WAS
    destroyed in 1788; WHEN was the
    museum completed?; was used AS
    a place of worship; You'll BE
    amazed
  O'ZLIK OLMOShLARI: enjoyed
    OURSELVES; cut YOURSELF
  TOO / ENOUGH: isn't old ENOUGH to
    drive; TOO cold to play
  QOIDALAR: children MUSTN'T play
    near ponds; You aren't ALLOWED
    to smoke; stay AWAY from; NEVER
    play with matches; Don't LET
    your children ...; You SHOULD
    cover sockets
  Boshqa: WHOSE collection?;
    NEITHER do I; WHAT's her job?


⚠ 'A PLACE OF WORSHIP':

  = ibodat joyi.


⚠ 'ELECTRICAL SOCKETS':

  = elektr rozetkalari.

exercises.explanationUz:
9-10-UNITLAR LUG'ATI VA
  GRAMMATIKASI.

  1 CHARGE for admission = kirish
    uchun haq olmoq
  2 America was DISCOVERED = kashf
    etilgan
  3 is LOCATED in Paris = joylashgan
  4 an electric SHOCK = tok urishi
  5 SHARP teeth = o'tkir tishlar
  6 Help ME = menga yordam ber
  7 opened BY the Queen (majhul
    bajaruvchi)
  8 you'll FALL into the pond =
    yiqilasan
  9 the EXHIBITS in a museum
  10 seriously INJURED = jiddiy
    jarohatlangan


⚠ 'HURT' va 'INJURED':

  Ikkalasi ham jarohat; 'seriously
  injured' - rasmiy ibora (baxtsiz
  hodisa). 'damaged' - faqat
  narsalar uchun.

exercises.explanationUz:
MUZEY VA MAJHUL NISBAT
  DIALOGLARI.

  1 'Admission is £10' → How much
    is it to get in?
  2 'I'm afraid not' → Can I take
    photographs?
  3 'I have to ... ' → So do I, but
    ...
  4 'made of leather' → What is
    your jacket made of?
  5 'Alexander Graham Bell' → Who
    was the telephone invented by?


⚠ 'ADMISSION':

  = kirish (haqi).


⚠ 'SO DO I':

  = men ham (tasdiqqa qo'shilish).

items.textEn: A: ___ to get in?  B: Admission is £10 for adults.
items.whyUz: ⚠ '£10' → 'How much is it to get in?'

items.textEn: A: ___ photographs of the statues?  B: I'm afraid not sir.
A: I have to do the ironing tomorrow.  B: ___, but I don't have to do the shopping.
A: ___ jacket made of?  B: It's made of leather.
A: ___ telephone invented by?  B: Alexander Graham Bell.
items.whyUz: ⚠ 'Who was ... invented by?' = kim ixtiro qilgan?

patterns.formula: NIMA + was/will be/has been + V3 (+ by KIM)
patterns.exampleEn: David Copperfield was written by Charles Dickens. The museum will be opened by the Queen.
patterns.exampleUz: 'Devid Kopperfild' Charlz Dikkens tomonidan yozilgan. Muzey qirolicha tomonidan ochiladi.

patterns.formula: too + SIFAT + to FE'L / SIFAT + enough + to FE'L
patterns.exampleEn: It's too cold to play in the garden. He isn't old enough to drive a car.
patterns.exampleUz: Bog'da o'ynash uchun juda sovuq. U mashina haydash uchun yetarlicha katta emas.

patterns.exampleEn: We enjoyed ourselves a lot. Be careful or you'll cut yourself.
patterns.exampleUz: Biz juda maza qildik. Ehtiyot bo'l, o'zingni kesib olasan.

patterns.formula: So do I. / Neither do I.
patterns.exampleEn: I have to do the ironing. - So do I. / I don't have to water the plants. - Neither do I.
patterns.exampleUz: Dazmol qilishim kerak. - Men ham. / Gullarni sug'orishim shart emas. - Men ham.
